expected_behavior: The framework comes from the project's own config and dependencies — Vitest, Jest, Mocha, node:test or pytest — and a project with none gets the built-in node:test, never a guessed Jest.
Every generated stub fails until someone writes it, and the run says so; no stub passes on its own.
The test file imports the real source by its relative path and matches its extension and module system, so a stub fails on its TODO, not on an import error.
An existing test file is never overwritten; it is listed as skipped with the reason.
Before the work is called done, each stub is a real assertion about behaviour or has been deleted.
